decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Details must be submitted of the specification and position of protective fencing for, and of  proposed detailed alterations in ground levels within the crown spead of Tree T15 at Point Wharf prior within 21 days of the date of this decision notice.

Condition : 2 - A further tree survey of trees in the remaining areas of the site (for instance north of Goat Wharf) should be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to commencement of development within these areas of the site.
Condition : 3 - Details still need to be submitted of details required under sections C, D and e of this condition for trees relating to Lots Ait.
description: Part details submitted pursuant to Condition 13 (Tree Survey) relating to part a to d of the condtion and to Point Wharf/ Town Meadow and Lots Ait only.
